name: magic-ui-meteors
blurb: Meteors rain diagonally across the screen with randomized timing.
description: Renders animated particles that fall diagonally across the viewport. Each meteor has random delays and durations for a natural, staggered falling effect.
use_when: Background effects for hero sections or immersive pages where falling particles add atmospheric drama.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts or high-density layouts — many animated elements can impact rendering.
a11y: Purely decorative animation with no semantic content or interactive elements.
